topic: The Attention Mechanism: How Transformers Read

sections.title: The Problem: Context Blindness
lecture_lines: Static word embeddings fail to capture polysemous meaning.
Words processed in isolation lose surrounding context.
Imagine a librarian ignoring everything but the first word.
animations: Fade in title: 'The Problem: Context Blindness' in #FFFFFF.

Highlight specific words to show lack of relationship.

sections.title: Core Concept: The 'Spotlight' Analogy
lecture_lines: Attention provides a dynamic spotlight mechanism.
Highly relevant words cast a brighter glow.
animations: Fade in title: 'Core Concept: The Spotlight Analogy'.
Display a static document text on screen. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/document.svg]
Introduce a 'spotlight' beam moving across the text.

sections.title: The Mechanism: Queries, Keys, and Values
lecture_lines: Query defines what I am looking for.
Key defines what I have to offer.
Value is the core information retrieved.
animations: Display labels for Query (Q), [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/magnifyingglass.svg] Key (K), and Value (V).
Show Q and [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/key.svg] K moving to perform a dot-product calculation.
Show output weights applied to V to reveal the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/treasure.svg].

sections.title: Mathematical Intuition: Scaled Dot-Product
lecture_lines: QK transpose measures similarity between words.
Scale by root dk for stability.
animations: Fade in MathTex: 'Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k))V'.
Highlight QK^T term in #FF00FF to show raw similarity [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/calculator.svg].
Highlight / sqrt(d_k) term in #00FFFF for scaling [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/scale.svg].
Show softmax function applied to the scaled values.
Final highlighting of the output weighted sum [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg].
